shared_elements: low-relief carving of animals in profile
justification: Both are low reliefs featuring animals in profile organized into horizontal registers, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A shows a narrative human scene — armed figures on a chariot with wheel, bow and spear driving over collapsing horses — while B shows no humans or objects at all, only stacked rows of schematic crouching quadrupeds, a bird, a snake-like form and abstract bands, rendered in a far more flattened, emblematic manner than A's overlapping, foreshortened naturalism.
